title: Clipto
summary: Fully local, natural language search over terabytes of media
content: Clipto: Fully local, natural language search over terabytes of media | Product Hunt Launching today Clipto Launching today Fully local, natural language search over terabytes of media 669 followers Fully local, natural language search over terabytes of media 669 followers Visit website Search Like Google Photos, but fully local. Turn the terabytes of video, audio, meetings, and files you work with into searchable memories, without uploading anything to the cloud. Clipto automatically tags people, dialogue, and scenes, so you can instantly find any moment buried in your media just by describing what you're looking for. It's fast too: on a MacBook Pro M5, Clipto indexed 2TB of videos in just 24 hours. Try Framer Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Chris Messina Raycast Hunter We've been honing Clipto's story for a few months. At the end of our last call @henry_kang proved the value of the product. He and his team were out in the desert, testing Clipto remotely : minimal reception, terabytes of footage sitting on his laptop, and he needed to find a specific shot for the launch video. He searched for: "the wide drone shot where the car enters the desert" . He didn't want "a cinematic moment." Not a "vibes" search. He knew he had the clip but in the pre-Clipto world, it would take hours of video scrubbing to find it. He found that clip in seconds using natural language to search over his own media, fully local. Just like Google Photos — but nothing lives in the cloud. This isn't an easy problem to solve. Henry's been pursuing this direction for over twenty years, when at CMU's Robotics Institute (my alma mater, FYI), he began pushing the limits of computer vision. We built TabTasker so you can edit PDFs, process images, transcribe audio, and access 50+ utilities without uploading a single file. Lastly, it is free to use. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team Awards More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Privacy • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 4 Day Rank Upvote • 210 points Follow TabTasker Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info tabtasker.com TabTasker Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/tabtasker Lightfield AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you Try Lightfield Promoted Similar Products LottaTools PDF tools directly in your browser DevBox The developer toolbox Subscribe Sign in Framer Launch websites with enterprise needs at startup speeds. Try Framer Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Çağlar SU TabTasker Maker 📌 Hi Product Hunt 👋 We are building TabTasker because we got tired of the same old problem. Every time I needed to format some JSON, convert a file, or run a quick AI prompt, I had to paste my data into a random website. It always felt a bit sketchy wondering where that information was actually going. So, we decided to build a toolbox that completely respects your privacy. TabTasker runs 100% locally right inside your browser. By using WebAssembly and ONNX Runtime Web, all the processing happens directly on your own machine. What this means for your daily workflow: Zero uploads: Your files, code, and text stay on your device. Instant speed: You get immediate results because there is no waiting on server traffic or queues. Absolute privacy: Nothing is saved on our end, and your data is never sent away. TabTasker runs entirely on your own device, we don’t have massive server bills. That means we can keep this toolbox 100% free with no paywalls or sign-ups. It is just a simple, honest digital workbench for the tasks you do every day. For your sensitive documents of photos, TabTasker is ready to support you with ultimate privacy. title: Second Brain for AI
summary: Persistent memory for Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor. Free.
content: Second Brain for AI: Persistent memory for Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor. Free. | Product Hunt Launching today Second Brain for AI Launching today Persistent memory for Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor. Free. 357 followers Persistent memory for Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor. Free. 357 followers Visit website LLM Memory Every AI conversation starts from zero. Your projects, decisions, and preferences disappear as soon as you close the chat. Second Brain fixes that. It is a self-hosted memory layer that works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client. You can store context once and recall it by meaning instead of keywords. It includes duplicate detection, semantic search, and a web UI. Built on Cloudflare, it offers a free tier and your data remains yours. MIT licensed. title: Wandesk
content: Wandesk: Build Your Own AI Desktop | Product Hunt Launched this week Wandesk Launched this week Build Your Own AI Desktop 925 followers Build Your Own AI Desktop 925 followers Visit website Productivity • No-code Platforms • AI Agents Wandesk is an AI desktop. Build the apps you need just by describing them. Plug in Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Kimi, Qwen — anything OpenAI-compatible. Apps share context. AI remembers you. All local. No signup. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Forum Team Awards More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Open Source • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launched this week # 1 Day Rank Upvote • 434 points Follow Wandesk Add to collection Share Company Info wandesk.ai GitHub Wandesk Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/wandesk-ai AppSignal Get the APM insights you need without enterprise price tags. Try AppSignal Promoted Similar Products Claude by Anthropic A family of foundational AI models 5.0 ( 820 reviews ) LLMs AI Chatbots Happycapy The agent-native computer, for the rest of us 4.7 ( 38 reviews ) AI Workflow Automation AI Engineer bolt.new Prompt, run, edit, and deploy full-stack web apps 4.4 ( 44 reviews ) AI Coding Agents Vibe Coding Tools Taskade One prompt. One app. One living workspace for teams. 4.7 ( 105 reviews ) No-Code App Builder No-Code AI Agent Builder Trae Adaptive AI IDE that helps you ship faster 4.7 ( 24 reviews ) AI Code Editors View more Subscribe Sign in Forum Threads p/wandesk-ai yanglongyun • 4d ago First thread here 👋 what's the first app you'd want AI to build for you? Hey folks Yang here I'm building Wandesk, an AI desktop where you describe an app and it gets built right there on your machine. Calorie tracker, reading list, invoice generator, bill splitter, whatever apps live next to chat, files, 0 3 View all Social X Framer Launch websites with enterprise needs at startup speeds. Try Framer Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment yanglongyun Wandesk Maker 📌 Hello everyone 👋 I'm Yang, building Wandesk for a while now. The short version: Wandesk is an AI desktop. You describe an app, AI builds it right there on your machine — a calorie tracker, a reading list, an invoice generator, whatever. Apps live alongside chat, files, tasks, and memory. AI remembers context across all of them. Plug in your own API keys (Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi — anything OpenAI-compatible). 🔒 100% local. 🆓 100% free. No signup, no account, no cloud lock-in. Your apps, your data, your machine. Why we built it: AI products today still treat conversation as the only surface. Conversation is good for intent, bad for persistence — you don't balance your budget in a chat window. We wanted a place where AI-generated software has shape and stays. Available now on macOS and Windows. Would love to hear: - What's the first app you'd want it to build for you? - Where does it break in the first 5 minutes? (it will. tell us.) — Yang Upvote (24) Report Share 4d ago Denitsa Penc
